baseline_contract: baseline_commit is the authoritative integration baseline and must be an ancestor of both develop and upstream/main. After a controlled upstream sync, advance baseline_ref and baseline_commit together to that integrated upstream commit.
entry_contract: One exact core path per entry. Record an existing roadmap task ID, explain why a downstream extension cannot work, and name changed regular tests/test_*.py unittest modules. CI executes every listed module and rejects failure, zero-test collection, or an all-skipped suite.
